test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Oct 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which telecom company became the first one in India to demonstrate the operation of the 5G network?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Airtel**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Leading telecom firm Bharti Airtel announced a strategic partnership with the steel-to-software conglomerate Tata group for 5G network solutions. 
 
• Based on open radio access network (ORAN) technology, the plan is to roll out the solution initially for India and subsequently for exports.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Airtel's original plan of collaborating with hardware and software players to build a 5G network at the lowest price.
 
• Bharti Airtel has roped in Tata Consultancy Service (TCS) for its system integration capability.
 
• This will provide a big boost to Indian innovation and manufacturing destinations.
